input.prompt: Two kinds of references. The FIRST image is the POSE reference: copy this exact body position. The other images are the STYLE and PERSON references: black-and-white studio photograph in the style of a home-gym instruction manual, plain light-grey seamless backdrop and light-grey floor, soft even lighting, slightly grainy monochrome print look, camera at floor level from the side, athlete facing to the RIGHT of the frame, full body visible, nothing cropped, no black border, no mat, no gym equipment, no text, no watermark, no logos. The man is the same as in the style references: short dark hair, clean-shaven, black sleeveless shirt, grey athletic shorts, white running shoes. POSE, exactly as in the first image (bottom of a Goliaz-standard push-up): the CHEST is pressed onto the floor and touches it; the hips, thighs and knees are held OFF the floor so that the body stays a straight rigid line from the chest through the hips to the heels, only the toes and the chest touch the floor; both hands are lifted a few centimetres off the floor with open palms facing down, the elbows are bent about 90 degrees and point up and backwards toward the hips, upper arms close to the body; head neutral, face looking at the floor.
